title: Output after paired input steps
statement: For every natural number $k$, Boolean words $w,s$ with $|s|\le |w|$, and natural number $j\le |s|$, running the specified split-emitting machine from its initial configuration on $w$ with buffer $s$ for $2j$ steps yields the configuration with state $0$, input head at position $j$, auxiliary head at position $j$, and output $(w\mathbin{\upharpoonright}j)$ with each bit repeated twice in order. Here $w\mathbin{\upharpoonright}j$ denotes the prefix of $w$ of length $j$.
